notes.title: Development News: Wild Realms is getting a revamp under a new name.
notes.content:
[p]Due to a variety of factors, I am making a successor/improved version of Wild Realms as a standalone game. Wild Realms wasn't exactly as good of a product as I had hoped for personally, and I am eager to re-enter the game development scene by starting with a clean slate. The newer game will feature the same systems as Wild Realms, but with more time, effort, and care poured into it. I am also not going to give out ETAs on things as I am a solo developer and things can change quickly.

"Devonian Swamplands" as well as existing time periods and more will be included into the new game. Wild Realms will remain as-is for now on Steam.

I know this may be upsetting to some, but this is the best way I know how to improve the gameplay: by remaking the game from scratch.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Performance pass on both maps (should boost FPS by about 5-10).

Fixed audio bug where damaging crabs did not give an audio cue.
Fixed Galapagos hawks being unable to let go of grabbed animals.
Minor stat changes to AI animals on the Cambrian Sponge-Reef.

-NPC movement enhancements (should be less robotic and more natural).

-New NPC creature: Yuyuanozoon

-Audio cue for damaging other animals.

-Primarily land-dwelling creatures will no longer sink to the seafloor.

notes.title: Wild Realms is now $4.99 USD
notes.content: Wild Realms' price tag has been reduced to $4.99 USD for now. The reason is to make the game easier to obtain and reflect the game's current content on offer.

notes.title: Updates resuming in January!
notes.content:
Wild Realms updates will soon resume in 2025 once the Holiday Season has concluded.  I'm planning on updating the game with a few more species as well as going over the gameplay polish and fixing bugs before I start to add more gameplay maps.

God Bless and have a merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

-sincerely, Daye Productions.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.content: Hopefully fixed a bug where NPC animals teleported when not rendered by the game.

notes.title: Wild Realms is Live!
notes.content:
Wild Realms is now available in initial release phase. This phase will likely last a few weeks or months until the game is ensured to be stable and mostly bug free before I add any major new content.

Please enjoy and have fun!

God Bless!
